title: Tail Trim Tank Transfer — Functional Test, VANTOR
abstract: Functional test of the tail trim tank transfer on the four-engine aircraft, including the timed valve response measurement at ambient and at simulated cold soak that the transfer schedule depends on.

sections.purpose: This task proves that the tail trim tank transfer valve reaches its commanded position within the time the centre of gravity schedule assumes, both at ambient temperature and after a simulated cold soak.
sections.job_setup_note: Do this task with the aircraft on jacks or level on its gear, with fuel in the trim tank and the wing tanks able to receive it. The cold soak part of the test needs the heater blanket set and takes several hours to stabilise; plan it as an overnight or a long shift. The timing set must be connected at the valve, not at the flight compartment indication, because the indication lags the mechanism.
sections.procedure: 1. Make sure that the trim tank contains at least the test quantity and that the wing tanks can receive it. 2. Connect the timing set at the transfer valve in zone 331. 3. Command a forward transfer from the flight compartment and record the time from command to the valve reaching its commanded position. 4. Repeat three times and take the mean. WARNING: DO NOT ENTER THE STABILIZER ACCESS AREA WHILE A TRANSFER IS IN PROGRESS. 5. Compare the mean against the ambient limit in the acceptance table. 6. Apply the heater blanket set in reverse to cold soak the valve to minus 30 degrees Celsius and let the temperature stabilise. CAUTION: DO NOT EXCEED THE COOLING RATE IN THE STANDARD PRACTICE. A RAPID RATE WILL CRACK THE VALVE BODY SEAL. 7. Repeat the timed measurement three times at the soaked condition and take the mean. 8. Compare against the cold limit in the acceptance table. 9. Check the upper non-return valve position 14QT for correct seating during the reverse flow part of the cycle. 10. Check that the upper transmitter position 40QT reads the transferred quantity within tolerance of the flight compartment indication. 11. On aircraft with the heater mat installed, check that the mat energises below minus 30 degrees Celsius and de-energises above it. 12. Restore the fuel distribution to the dispatch configuration.
sections.close_out: Remove the timing set and the heater blanket set. Do a leak check of any joint that was disturbed. Record the six timed measurements, the two means and the transmitter tolerance in the aircraft technical log. A mean outside either limit is a no-go item and must not be deferred.

type_data.effectivity_note: Four-engine aircraft only; the twin-engine aircraft have no tail trim tank. Step 11 applies post MOD-132640

safety_precautions: Do not enter the stabilizer access area while a transfer is in progress.
Earth the aircraft for the whole test.
Do not exceed the cooling rate given in the standard practice.
